diagnosis.scope: Post-hoc shape and phase diagnosis of the crossing. Not a ladder point, not a capacity value and not part of the verdict.
differs_from_ladder_runner_in: CUEXIS_GPU_TIMER is 1 instead of 0, so the probe writes and drains GL timestamp queries;
the identity expectation is timer:true and every sample must carry gpu_interval_us;
one extra validity problem ('sample without gpu_interval_us');
the registration records timer:true and a diagnostic-only scope.
diagnosis.why: The ladder measures CPU wall time per frame and is blind to where inside the frame the time goes. The timer draws a begin/end GPU timestamp pair around backend.submit, which separates 'the GPU was busy' from 'the CPU was inside the submit call'.
diagnosis.caveat: The timer is an extra synchronisation point and a different runner: its numbers may be cited only as a labelled post-hoc diagnostic and are never merged into a ladder point or its verdict.
